text: Vorn (female) serves as a Marshal field agent on a Ranger crew within the galactic_union faction (org_union_marshals).

Frontier Enforcement Escalation Study (sim capture): demonstrated aggressive forward momentum; actively pursued retreating hostile elements; used bracer-mounted repulsion device to redirect a thrown munition back toward hostile forces (premature detonation).
Operates in doctrinal pair with Cross as a single tactical unit.
Standard Marshal kit plus distinctive bracer-mounted short-range impulse repulsion device (only established use: munition redirection).
